title: Product Semantic Contract
description: What this product must never get semantically wrong. Separate from the Visual Manifest on purpose: that one answers `what does it look like`, this one answers `what must stay true`. Shape only — the Factory does not know what any statement means, and never infers one.

$schema.description: Optional schema pointer, for editors only.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. A different number is a different contract.

invariants.description: The product's semantic invariants. An empty array is a legitimate product — but it is a decision, and the gate says so out loud.

id.description: Stable, machine-readable, language-free. Dotted lowercase kebab, at least two segments — e.g. `tension.resolved-requires-fact-change`. Never a Chinese sentence, never a test title.

statement.description: What must never happen, in the product's own language. This sentence is the only context the next reader gets.

enforcement.description: How the invariant is held. `test` means a test in this repo registers the id through tests/support/product-contract.ts. The list is short on purpose: every value must come with a way to verify it.
